mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.name, r.created_at AS createdAt, m_last.content AS lastMessage, m_last.sent_at AS lastMessageAt, (SELECT nickname FROM member m JOIN messenger_member mm2 ON m.id = mm2.member_id WHERE mm2.room_id = r.id AND mm2.member_id != #{memberId} LIMIT 1) AS otherMemberName, (SELECT profile_image_url FROM member m JOIN messenger_member mm2 ON m.id = mm2.member_id WHERE mm2.room_id = r.id AND mm2.member_id != #{memberId} LIMIT 1) AS otherMemberProfileImage FROM messenger_room r JOIN messenger_member mm ON r.id = mm.room_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m1.room_id, m1.content, m1.sent_at FROM messenger_message m1 JOIN ( SELECT room_id, MAX(id) as max_id FROM messenger_message GROUP BY room_id ) m2 ON m1.id = m2.max_id ) m_last ON r.id = m_last.room_id WHERE mm.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY m_last.sent_at DESC NULLS LAST, r.created_at DESC

SELECT mm1.room_id FROM messenger_member mm1 JOIN messenger_member mm2 ON mm1.room_id = mm2.room_id WHERE mm1.member_id = #{memberId} AND mm2.member_id = #{friendId} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messenger_member mm3 WHERE mm3.room_id = mm1.room_id) = 2 LIMIT 1
